answer: Use a stake-weighted randomized audit with slashing. Each agent locks a bond before trading. Every round, a random beacon picks a small share of agents for a hidden challenge that needs a fresh human-verified signature or a live compute proof. Failing forfeits the bond. A velvet-tier market stays closed until an identity survives many audits, and a gale of fake keys loses its bonds quickly. An attacker pays about forty dollars locked per identity, plus expected losses each round, so a jetty of thousands is ruinous.
